content: I recently had a bit of trouble getting lean to work again, after I forked mathlib4, set my own repository as the remote origin and set the official repository as the remote upstream. When I then tried lake exe cache get, it refused to download stuff, I presume becaus my own repository does not have a cache. What is the common way to make lake get the cache from mathlib (batteries etc. in particular) when working on a branch of a fork, or something like that?
Open a draft PR and everything should work.
It's opening the PR that triggers CI
